main_body: snow-covered roofed well with stone base and open top
top_band: snow-covered roof (rows 1-8, white and pale blue-grey) and elliptical stone rim + dark interior opening (rows 16-23)
evidence: The well shows a clear 8-row foreshortened snow roof on top (rows 1-8) overhanging the wooden posts, and the stone basin below has an elliptical opening visible from above (rows 16-23, with 6 rows of dark interior between the back and front rims) above a 7-row vertical brick front face (rows 24-30).

style.evidence: Compared to the reference roofed well directly beside it, the candidate's stonework is a rigid, repetitive dark-lined brick grid lacking the individual stone highlights and rich value variation of the reference. The bucket is a flat 2-tone brown block without rim or shading detail, and the wooden posts and snow roof are noticeably simpler and flatter than the reference's textured surfaces.
